# Elizabeth Vijan — Scottsdale & Phoenix Real Estate Agent

> Elizabeth Vijan is a licensed Arizona real estate agent (AZ license SA708105000) based in Scottsdale, AZ, with the Tackett Team at eXp Realty and a member of ARMLS (Arizona Regional Multiple Listing Service). A Scottsdale native and Arizona State University business graduate, she helps buyers and sellers across Scottsdale and Central Phoenix.

## Areas served
- Scottsdale, AZ
- Arcadia (Phoenix)
- Arcadia Lite (Phoenix)
- Central Phoenix
- Moon Valley (Phoenix)
- Chaparral Park, Scottsdale (85250): https://chaparralparkhomes.com/
